title: Cross-Benchmark Consistency Auditor for Agent Safety Scores

original_idea.body: # Cross-Benchmark Consistency Auditor for Agent Safety Scores

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: benchmark inconsistency makes single-benchmark governance fragile; consistency audit improves validity.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: run models across several benchmarks + compute rank-correlation; multi-benchmark setup adds effort.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (consistency report + rank-correlation), 3-4 benchmarks is multi-workstream-ish.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected meta-infrastructure; API-only, field-wide measurement validity.

novelty.reasoning: Taxonomy paper exists; reusable consistency-auditor tool may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A reusable cross-benchmark consistency auditor likely missing.
